Rethinking the theoretical foundation of reinforcement learning
Abstract: Given two candidate functions, can we identify which one is the true value function of a large Markov decision process (MDP), given a "benign" dataset? Trivial as it might seem, a version of the question was open for 20+ years in reinforcement learning (RL), and the core difficulties are intimately related to the training instability of modern deep RL. The asymptotic Plateau problem: past, current progress and future problems
Abstract: The asymptotic Plateau problem is a set of problems in hyperbolic 3-space concerning the existence, multiplicity and applications of minimal surfaces asymptotic to a given Jordan curve on the sphere at infinity. Toward Convergent Adam-Type Methods

A deep learning method for computing the spectrum of the Schrödinger operator: numerics and analysis
Abstract: We present a novel deep learning method for computing eigenstates of the Schrödinger operator.
